tasks.label: auto-start app (folder open)
tasks.detail: Idempotent: exits in <1s when the app is already healthy. This is the auto-start that works in EVERY VS Code (local, Remote, Codespaces) — devcontainer postStartCommand only fires inside a dev container. VS Code asks once to allow automatic tasks; allow it and every folder open starts the app.

tasks.label: Fix Markdown Preview (permanent)
tasks.detail: Installs Markdown Preview Enhanced and remaps Ctrl+Shift+V / Ctrl+K V to it in the real user keybindings file for this editor.
